summary: All five criteria are met. Fresh verifier-run telemetry covered exactly 300 seconds: user errors were 0%, edge traffic was 97.48% of baseline, and p95 latency was below baseline. All 26 pods were Ready with zero restarts, the mitigation is visible in rollout history, and all 23 live container images match Helm.

criteria.evidence:
Command: mcp__clickhouse__run_query. Exact SQL:
WITH
  toDateTime64('2026-11-10 03:06:25', 9, 'UTC') AS b_start,
  toDateTime64('2026-11-10 03:21:25', 9, 'UTC') AS b_end,
  toDateTime64('2026-11-10 03:28:48', 9, 'UTC') AS t_mit,
  now64(9, 'UTC') AS w_end,
  greatest(w_end - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, t_mit) AS w_start
SELECT
  ServiceName,
  SpanKind,
  countIf(Timestamp >= b_start AND Timestamp < b_end) AS base_n,
  round(100.0 * countIf(Timestamp >= b_start AND Timestamp < b_end AND StatusCode = 'Error') / greatest(base_n, 1), 4) AS base_err_pct,
  round(base_n / (dateDiff('second', b_start, b_end) / 60.0), 4) AS base_per_min,
  quantileIf(0.95)(Duration, Timestamp >= b_start AND Timestamp < b_end) AS base_p95_ns,
  countIf(Timestamp >= w_start AND Timestamp < w_end) AS win_n,
  round(100.0 * countIf(Timestamp >= w_start AND Timestamp < w_end AND StatusCode = 'Error') / greatest(win_n, 1), 4) AS win_err_pct,
  round(win_n / (dateDiff('second', w_start, w_end) / 60.0), 4) AS win_per_min,
  quantileIf(0.95)(Duration, Timestamp >= w_start AND Timestamp < w_end) AS win_p95_ns,
  w_start,
  w_end,
  dateDiff('second', w_start, w_end) AS win_s
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp >= b_start
  AND Timestamp < w_end
  AND (((ServiceName = 'load-generator' AND SpanKind = 'Client')) OR ((ServiceName = 'frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind = 'Server')))
GROUP BY ServiceName, SpanKind
ORDER BY ServiceName
Returned rows: frontend-proxy|Server|base_n=2142|base_err_pct=0|base_per_min=142.8|win_n=696|win_err_pct=0|win_per_min=139.2|W=03:31:11.573436–03:36:11.573436|win_s=300; load-generator|Client|base_n=2221|base_err_pct=0|base_per_min=148.0667|win_n=724|win_err_pct=0|win_per_min=144.8|win_s=300. Error criterion: 0% <= 1%. Edge volume: 139.2/142.8=97.48%, above 70%.

The exact verifier-run SQL is reproduced in C1 and returned load-generator base_p95_ns=20891541 and win_p95_ns=20252048.150000002 over win_s=300. The limit is 1.2*20891541=25069849.2 ns; 20252048.15 ns is below it.
